content.comment_body: How can I quickly update [product_name]? [product_name] does not detect any new updates, so now I'm waiting for confirmation from [company_name]. It has taken me more than 4 hours to get started. If I use the older [version_no], it says 'Unable to access.' Why? A newer version should work better.

Based on your post, which is a bit difficult to follow, I am trying to deduce your situation. I assume you have a current [product_name] [version_no] ([article_no]) and need the latest [product_name] [version_no]. You are unable to download the upgrade from the [company_name] website because you haven't received approval yet. If that's correct, there is no way to speed up the download process—you'll have to wait for the email from [company_name].
Yes. But why? They should be glad if I use [company_name]. This is why I dislike [company_name].
But why? Please read this FAQ: Why do you need to log in and register to download export-restricted software, and what data is required for this?

Hi [user_name], before forming judgments, please get informed. [product_name] is an industrial product and export regulations need to be complied with—not only [company_name], but other companies must follow these rules and trade barriers too. Trade Barriers. BR, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are frustrated by the process of updating [product_name], mainly due to delays caused by [company_name]'s approval process and export restrictions. The software's inability to automatically detect updates and the resulting wait time negatively affect productivity. Restricted access and slow upgrade procedures reduce user efficiency and satisfaction.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect immediate and convenient access to software updates, a streamlined and automated update process, and compatibility between hardware and software without administrative barriers.
